segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: THUD-THUD-THUD!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Heavy wooden boots echoed down the spiral stone staircase.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SEARCH SQUAD ADVANCING!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: a cheery mechanical voice chirped from the shadows.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: COMMENCE THOROUGH HOLIDAY APPREHENSION!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Three towering Nutcracker guards rounded the corner of the subterranean vault. These weren't ordinary sentries—they were the Nutcracker Special Contingent. They wore midnight-blue dress coats with polished silver tassels, tall bear-fur hats, and massive silver keys slowly turning in their backs: click-click-click.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Their painted porcelain grins were so wide and shiny you could see your reflection in their teeth.

segments.speaker: soldier
segments.text: UNAUTHORIZED CIVILIANS IN RESTRICTED CLOCK VAULT,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the lead soldier announced with aggressive merriment.

segments.speaker: soldier
segments.text: PREPARE TO RECEIVE FESTIVE CORRECTION.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip squeezed behind your winter jacket, trembling so hard his detective hat slid over his left eye.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Right then, recruit,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip squeaked, pushing the Clockmaker’s leather journal deeper into his coat pocket.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I have thoroughly analyzed our tactical options. My official recommendation is that we scream, throw rocks, and faint in alphabetical order.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: No,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you whisper, scanning the workbench.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: They're machines, Pip. They have rules. They can't help following their programming!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You spot three items within arm's reach on the workbench:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: An antique sprig of polished brass mistletoe with tiny jingle bells.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A beautifully wrapped, empty red holiday gift box with an elaborate golden silk bow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A pair of long iron clock-tweezers right next to the soldiers' spinning back-keys.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: What silly trick do you use to stop the Nutcrackers?
